data.desc: Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, SINTX Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SINT) is an advanced biomaterials company that develops, manufactures, and commercializes patented and proprietary silicon nitride ceramic biomaterials, composites, devices, and related ceramics technologies for other medical and specialized industrial applications. SINTX has 20 years of experience innovating silicon nitride technologies and operates under a quality management system certified to ISO 13485:2016 and AS9100D, with a product portfolio that includes insulators for Tier 1 aerospace suppliers, the FDA-cleared SiNAPTIC Foot & Ankle Osteotomy Wedge System for reconstructive surgery, OEM manufacturing of FDA-cleared spinal implants, and its SiNERGY technology platform being developed for biocomposite and 3D printing applications.
